title: STILL PRESENT (r4): N8 malformed-at gate (send_is_malformed) has no test — and the prefix-unanchored regex still lets date-range-invalid ats raise in the cast
evidence:
webhooks.gleam:285: "let genuine_failure = case row.send_is_malformed {
                True -> False
                False ->
                  row.matched_send_at == "" || row.send_is_post_correction"
SQL: "SELECT NOT (e->>'at' ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}[T ][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}')"
detail: grep of server/test/integration/*.gleam: zero hits for send_is_malformed/matched_send_at and no malformed-at fixture — the r4 test-gap carries forward. Regex is prefix-only (no $), so an at like 2026-13-01T08:00:00 passes it and the (e->>'at')::timestamptz cast still raises, aborting the find (Sentry-capture, event dropped).
recommended_fix: Add an integration fixture with a malformed at (e.g. 'garbage') on a post-correction delivered entry: bounce stands down (queued, no exhaust, no stamp). Control: valid-at referee bounce still exhausts. Anchor/validate the regex so cast-raise is impossible.

title: STILL PRESENT (r4): N15 partial — prefill-level pins (UserChoseRefcheckAction -> empty/effective prefill) and the 'fires nothing' eff assertions were NOT added
evidence: client_test.gleam:6389: "let #(updated, eff) = client.update(m, msg.UserSavedRefcheckEdit("rc-1"))" — eff bound, never asserted; the only UserChoseRefcheckAction drivers are RefcheckStart (6315) and RefcheckSkip (6333).

detail: The r4 N13 arm is correct in code and the row-body substitute surface is pinned (objected_row_substitute_surface_test), but a regression emptying the Objected (or Unreachable) menu would fail no test — the §7.3 menu table contract for terminal rows is only half-pinned.

title: Per-row scoping of the r4 rework (N1 edit dict, N17 confirm clear) is unpinned — no two-row test exercises it
detail: The exact regression N1/N17 guard against (one row's action discarding another row's typed trio or confirm) is untested; all current tests would stay green if the success arm cleared the whole edit dict. Render-level scoping is pinned; handler-level is not.
recommended_fix: Two-row handler test: open an edit on rc-2, succeed an action on rc-1, assert rc-2's trio and confirm survive; same for the failure arm re-enabling only the matching row.
